description: Phase 12 default training configuration for the 5 models x 10 folds x 2 data arms matrix. Preprocessing is the existing CLAHE pipeline (configs/preprocess_v2_clahe.json); augmentation is the existing src/augmentation.py default; head_then_full = classifier head only for head_epochs, then everything with a smaller backbone learning rate (the baseline's staged idea, generalised). Values are starting points, not tuned.
